items.title: Honda launches ZR-V Hybrid SUV in India at ₹47.99 lakh, begins deliveries
items.summary: The ZR-V e:HEV is powered by Honda’s 2.0-litre e:HEV Sports Hybrid powertrain, delivering a combined maximum power of 184 PS at 5,000-6,000 rpm and maximum torque of 315 Nm at 0-2,000 rpm.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz India rolls out E25-compliant cars amid biofuel push
items.summary: Customer demand shows a growing interest in electric mobility and hybrid technologies. Mercedes-Benz India expects stable luxury car sales with single-digit growth this year.
